name: Sample: small business
description: A sample template for a small or medium business: an internal IT role group and an external support partner role group (each with an L0-T0 high-privilege variant), task and service groups for Entra ID, Azure and Defender XDR, administrative units per level, and the delegations between them. Import the permission packs entra-roles-reference and defender-xdr first: this sample nests their groups. Replace the example management group names (they start with mg-) with your own.
